title: Group 1: ionisation energy and reactivity
caption: Down group 1 the outer s electron is further out and more shielded, so first ionisation energy falls from 520 to 376 kJ mol⁻¹. The electron is lost more easily, so reactivity with water rises from lithium to caesium.
alt: Bar chart of first ionisation energies of Li 520, Na 496, K 419, Rb 403, Cs 376 kJ/mol, falling down the group.
description: Li 520, Na 496, K 419, Rb 403, Cs 376 kJ mol⁻¹: each lower, each more reactive.
